install.detail: tarball/apt, 1 demon + shim na VM; proprietarni licence; vyzaduje Docker ucet (login) a skupinu kvm

headless.detail: vse bez TTY pres sg kvm; template save u bezici VM chce TTY (--force neexistuje), exec -d nepodporovan; login ucet nutny

adapter.detail: orchestrator/adapters/sbx.py create/exec/destroy overen; tar/stdin pres sbx exec -i funguje

egress.detail: default-deny, probe: 1.1.1.1, DNS, metadata, LAN, host:22 blokovano (TCP connect prijat transparentnim proxy, data ne); allow per sandbox/domena/IP

credentials.detail: set-custom: placeholder -> FAKE-SECRET v hlavickach na libovolny host (IP), v sandboxu necitelne; na jiny host zustal placeholder; lokalne jen hlavicky, ne telo/URL; HTTPS custom nezkouseno

gateway.detail: llm-gw dosazitelna po allow; zdrojova IP = host pro vsechny sandboxy, tj. IP->klic mapovani nefunguje; identita pres per-sandbox secret/hlavicku nebo policy log; pkg-gw reseno allow domen v sbx; e2e s LiteLLM neoverena

compose.detail: 15/15 healthy za 19 s, nslookup OK, bez privileged

isolation.detail: samostatna VM a rootfs, mezi sandboxy a na hosta jen pres proxy policy; workspace se stejnou cestou je sdileny rw virtiofs

lifecycle.detail: rm uklidi vse; stop/start retains FS; template save+create -t snapshot funguje; pause/resume neni; 2-3 paralelni OK

docker_traffic.detail: objem provozu na Docker nezmeren (chybi tcpdump); SBX_NO_TELEMETRY=1 create/exec funguje

verdict: Technicky nejpropracovanejsi: mikroVM, host-side proxy s default-deny, set-custom tajemstvi pro libovolny host a compose bez privileged vse fungovalo. Proti PoC hraje povinny Docker ucet/login, proprietarni licence a to, ze gateway nemuze rozlisovat ulohy podle zdrojove IP.
